record.question: Which RBC parameter is evolutionarily conserved across species?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — MCHC. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 7, printed Q25. Source limitation: The stem claims across species broadly, whereas evidence is limited to adult mammals/birds; cannot make a universal conserved-parameter claim. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
